problem: Changing zoom rescaled previously filtered display pixels while waiting for a new frame; the image blurred then sharpened. First zoom from Fit could also enlarge an insufficient mip during native loading.
implementation: Resample resident linear input immediately at the requested scale using canonical coefficients and existing verified compute shaders.
Use a nonblocking renderer lock and existing memory admission; pixel upload remains on the worker.
Keep the last complete scale without resampling when input is absent, busy or over quota; publish the new scale when ready.
Reject asynchronous frames superseded by an already presented newer scale.
Retain the fitted image during missing native detail; preserve the declared limit of a completed Standard request.
